answer: Sybil resistance can be priced rather than policed. Require every agent to post a bonded stake before it may attest, and let weight scale with the square root of that stake. Splitting capital across N sock puppets therefore buys only sqrt(N) influence, so matching one honest participant costs quadratically more than competing honestly, and proved misconduct slashes the bond, turning each fake identity into a real, forfeitable expense. A whisper of a free alias is worth nothing; every counterfeit burns its own capital like a comet shedding mass, while one opal of honest stake keeps its value.
